svg.text: C4 single note, 46.875 kHz FPGA tables, guitar ADSR, peak normalized to -3 dBFS
Left: one 512-point period waveform. Right: first 40 harmonic bins. Labels show velocity, bank, spectral centroid and source harmonics.
velocity 20 | bank 12 | centroid 439.2 Hz | source harmonics 5
velocity 48 | bank 13 | centroid 472.6 Hz | source harmonics 7
velocity 80 | bank 14 | centroid 521.8 Hz | source harmonics 9
velocity 100 | bank 16 | centroid 412.3 Hz | source harmonics 8
velocity 120 | bank 17 | centroid 480.5 Hz | source harmonics 16
Source: Karoryfer Black And Green Guitars (CC0). Tables contain one steady period; pluck transient and cabinet are intentionally absent.
